title: Add EasyNav release team
author: fmrico
body:
* Name of the new release team: easynav
* Release repositories to add:
 
  * [yaets](https://github.com/fmrico/yaets.git)
    * [In process](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/47801) of release to rosdistro. **Update:** canceled waiting for this issue.
    * [x] There is an existing release repository which should be imported: https://github.com/fmrico/yaets-release.git
  * [NavMap](https://github.com/EasyNavigation/NavMap.git)
    * [In process](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/47798) of release to rosdistro. **Update:** canceled waiting for this issue.
    * [x] There is an existing release repository which should be imported: https://github.com/EasyNavigation/NavMap-release.git
  * [EasyNav](https://github.com/EasyNavigation/EasyNavigation.git)
    * [In process](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/47804) of release to rosdistro. **Update:** canceled waiting for this issue.
    * [x] There is an existing release repository which should be imported: https://github.com/EasyNavigation/EasyNavigation-release.git
  * [easynav_plugins](https://github.com/EasyNavigation/easynav_plugins.git)
    * No releases yet.
    * [ ] There is no existing release repository, so it has to be created.

* Team members
  * [@fmrico](https://github.com/fmrico)
  * [@Butakus](https://github.com/Butakus)
  * [@jmguerreroh](https://github.com/jmguerreroh)
  * [@estherag](https://github.com/estherag)
  * [@juanscelyg](https://github.com/juanscelyg)

comments.author: fmrico
comments.body:
Hi @nuclearsandwich 

I have just added `easynav_plugins`. Is there anything else we have to do in this process?

Thanks!!

comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body:
Hi @fmrico looking at the repositories above, I see yaets is indexed in ROS 2 Jazzy but the others are not yet indexed. In other words, they do not yet have a source entry in a ROS 2 distribution. It's unfortunately convoluted but before assigning release repositories we ask that packages get source entries listed in rosdistro so that they undergo naming and license review.

I'd suggest re-opening the linked PRs for NavMap, EasyNav, and easy_nav plugins but removing the release stanzas. They can be added in later or just re-released from the updated release repository.

Since yaets is already indexed, I've mirrored the release repository into https://github.com/ros2-gbp/yaets-release but I'll give it a bit of time before I wire up the terraform permissions in case the others come through this weekend.

comments.author: fmrico
comments.body:
Hi @nuclearsandwich 

Following your instructions, I have just released an updated version of all the interdependent packages, to have a source entry in `kilted`:

- [yaets](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/48018), pointing to https://github.com/fmrico/yaets-release.git begause I still have no permissions in https://github.com/ros2-gbp/yaets-release
- [NavMap](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/48019)
- [EasyNav](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/48020)
- [easynav-plugins](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/48021)

Please, let me know if I have made any mistakes in the process.

Thanks!!

comments.author: cottsay
comments.body:
I have freshly mirrored `yaets-release` and `NavMap-release` into `ros2-gbp`. Since `EasyNav` and `easynav-plugins` haven't made it into any ROS distributions yet, they will need to be handled in a follow-up ticket.

I recommend updating Kilted and Jazzy to use the new release repositories under `ros2-gbp` so that all of the distributions are in the same place, at which time you may decommission the existing release repos.

comments.author: fmrico
comments.body:
Thanks @cottsay !!

We will open a ticket as soon as `easynav` and  `easynav-plugins` are released.
